instruction:
Reset Absolute Coordinates To Local Model Space

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided georeferenced model so the product geometry is near the local origin while preserving georeferencing metadata, then save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcDoor, 2 IfcWindow entities, 3 IfcOpeningElement entities, 3 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, 3 IfcRelFillsElement relationships, 1 IfcProjectedCRS, and 1 IfcMapConversion.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcSpace, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Ground Floor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The product names are exactly South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Base Slab, Entry, Win E, and Win W, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. South Wall and North Wall each have bounding-box dimensions 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, East Wall and West Wall each have 0.20 m by 8.00 m by 3.00 m, Base Slab has 12.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.25 m, Entry has 0.244 m by 0.115 m by 1.083 m, and Win E and Win W each have 0.119 m by 0.075 m by 0.119 m, each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. All walls, the slab, door, and windows are spatially assigned to Ground Floor.
10. The IfcProjectedCRS name is exactly EPSG:3857, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
11. The IfcMapConversion has Eastings 1000000.000, Northings 2000000.000, OrthogonalHeight 0.000, XAxisAbscissa 1.000, XAxisOrdinate 0.000, and Scale 1.000, each with tolerance +/-0.001.
12. The absolute value of every generated product bounding-box coordinate is no greater than 200.00 m in the model local coordinate system.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
